newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Tennis-Courier survives first-round scare at Open.
newsitem.headline: Tennis-Courier survives first-round scare at Open.

text.p: Former champion Jim Courier survived a first-round scare at the Australian Open on Tuesday, beating Dutchman Sjeng Schalken 8-6 in the last set of a five-set thriller.
The number 11 seed beat Schalken 6-7 (4-7) 6-3 4-6 6-1 8-6 in a match lasting nearly four hours.
Courier, world ranked 16, won two consecutive titles in Melbourne from 1992 but has not reached a grand slam final since losing to Pete Sampras at Wimbledon in 1993.
The American failed to impose his game on Schalken, world ranked 85, struggling with his backhand and making 10 double faults in a scrappy baseline duel.
Courier meets Slava Dosedel of the Czech Republic in the second round. Dosedel beat France's Guy Forget in four sets.
